sourceSentences: Gaining Demon Shade resets Whiplash's cooldown and Empowered Whiplash its next cast.
Attacking or casting abilities ends Demon Shade immediately and places it on a 4-second static cooldown, reduced to 1.25 seconds from casting Last Caress.
Last Caress will reduces Demon Shade's cooldown after its cast time but before its blink delay, causing Evelynn to enter Demon Shade 0.75 seconds after blinking.
Casting Allure does not break Demon Shade nor its fade into it.
An enemy champion cursed by Allure is alarmed of her presence and after the mark has fully formed, an arrow will appear next to them pointing towards Evelynn's direction.

Evelynn's next basic attack or ability hit against the target consumes the mark, slowing them by 45% for 0.75 seconds and refunding Allure's mana cost. If the target was marked for at least 2.5 seconds, the consumption is empowered.

The magic resistance reduction debuff is applied independently of the Charm debuff when the matured mark is expunged, meaning a target can still have their magic resistance reduced while they are resisting applications of CC debuffs (e.g. Black Shield).
Evelynn launches a dart in the target direction, dealing magic damage to the first enemy hit and marking them for 4 seconds.
Evelynn reveals her true form, becoming untargetable at the start of the cast time and then unleashing her lashers in a cone in the target direction
After 0.5 seconds, she blinks 700 units in the opposite direction and becomes targetable again.
The casting input controls the direction Last Caress' damage is dealt from, with the movement automatically happening in the reverse direction.
Last Caress can be buffered during Empowered Whiplash.
Evelynn will track the target if they change locations. She will not stop tracking the target until she reaches them, as there is no maximum tracking distance.
Empowered Whiplash can be blocked but cannot be dodged and/or missed if Evelynn is blinded.
For combos, an easy go-to is to Q into W just before the Q lands and to using Q twice more. E into an attack then use your final Q before attacking away using ult to execute.
Your CC combo is to start with W and let it proc. From here, use Q into your second Q and E. Spam out your remaining Qs while attacking using ult to execute.
And a combo to secure a kill is use W into ulting backwards to dash towards your target. From here, Q into an attack and E before spamming out your three remaining Qs.
Only on the first target you hit with Q1 will your Q2 attacks deal more damage.
When W is fully charged, an arrow appears on the target, indicating which direction you are approaching from.
When you reach level six, use the combination W, Q, Q, E, Q, auto attack, Q, auto attack, R.
With her ultimate, you can cancel shots from turrets.
When you are chasing an opponent, you can use her ultimate to close the distance. You can also use your ultimate to dodge any ability or escape from opponents.
